provider_name: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
access_description: Public Board H.15 Data Download zip. No key. Series H15/H15/RIFLGFCM03_N.M is the monthly market yield on United States Treasury securities at 3-month constant maturity, quoted on an investment basis, per cent per year. Bound only after the downloaded file repeated that series name and description. This is not the discount-basis 3-month Treasury bill RIFSGFSM03_N.M, not the federal funds rate, not a near-term forward spread, not a Treasury XML yield, and not FRED. The daily business-day series is not stored.
auth_requirement: No key is described for the public H.15 download package.
conditions: Cite the Board. Do not use Board seals or logos. Copying covers Board information; the disclaimer still requires permission for non-Board photos, graphics, and trademarks. Do not present this level as a near-term forward spread. Do not substitute the discount-basis Treasury bill or the federal funds rate.
revision_behaviour: The downloaded file is the current latest-revised package. It does not carry a historical vintage for each month, so these rows are not a vintage panel. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. This series is not a near-term forward spread.
unresolved_questions: The disclaimer does not discuss AI processing or model training, so those decisions stay unknown. The package does not state a seasonal adjustment, so the stored seasonal adjustment is unknown. The file header says the Data Download Program build tool is due to be removed in the week of 9 November 2026 and points users to FRED. This row does not use FRED, because FRED retention is prohibited. Whether this zip address will remain after that week is not stated.
evidence_note: On 31 October 2026 the Board H.15 zip returned HTTP 200. Inside H15_data.xml, DataSet id H15 and schema H15_H15, the series repeats H15/H15/RIFLGFCM03_N.M: SERIES_NAME RIFLGFCM03_N.M, FREQ 129 (Monthly), UNIT Percent:_Per_Year (Percent: Per Year), and long description 'Market yield on U.S. Treasury securities at 3-month constant maturity, quoted on investment basis' (the file has a double space after '3-month'). There are 541 monthly observations from 1981-09-30 to 2026-09-30. The same file also names RIFSGFSM03_N.M, the 3-month Treasury bill secondary market rate on a discount basis (the file has a double space before 'discount'). That bill was not stored. Federal funds RIFSPFF_N.M was not stored as this yield. This is not FRED. The package is one latest-revised file, not a vintage panel. This series is not a near-term forward spread. ND is an omitted period: the package encodes it as OBS_STATUS ND and OBS_VALUE -9999, and that sentinel is not stored as zero. The daily business-day series is not stored. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume these dataset ids. Sahm and PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE require bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. This dataset id is fed.h15.RIFLGFCM03_N.M.
